# Macenza

> Macenza delivers AI software solutions, automation systems, high-performance web applications, and custom digital transformation solutions.

## About Macenza
Macenza is an AI software development company specializing in custom web applications, SaaS platforms, HRMS software, AI integration, and workflow automation.

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Website Development**: Custom frontend websites and headless CMS integrations built using modern web tech stacks.
- **Web Applications**: Tailored SaaS platforms and internal business portals using React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
- **Custom HRMS Software**: Human resource management dashboards integrating time tracking, automated payroll calculations, and job applicant queues (Hrenso - https://www.hrenso.com/).
- **AI Integration & Solutions**: Machine learning integration, language model APIs (OpenAI API, PyTorch, Python), document categorization, and customer service routing.
- **Automation Solutions**: Background scheduled pipelines, cron jobs, scripts, and webhooks for cross-platform data synchronization.
- **Hotel Management Software**: Custom software for hotel bookings, room allocation, guest management, billing, and staff operations.
